programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: National Treasures
programme.desc: In this programme, he visits Plas Newydd on the island of Anglesey in north west Wales, which the Trust acquired in the 1970s. Once it was the family home of the Marquis of Anglesey, and now property manager Nerys Jones has to think of new ways to attract visitors to this remote location.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: We will start in Asia to discover the attractive and enigmatic Vietnam from a unique perspective while riding a bicycle and then tour the tunnels of war. We will get to know the city of Ho Chi Minh where the cultural and economic life that defines all of Vietnam is established. During our tour, you will appreciate the city's French colonial architecture and its endless caravans of motorcycles that circulate all over. Then we will go to London, on a tour of the famous red buses that first circulate in London since 1956. After a visit to the Big Bent, we'll go enjoy a rich portion of fish-and-chips, the traditional London street-food, in a city full of multiple possibilities. Our trip finishes in Los Angeles, the city where everything you can imagine becomes reality thanks to all the talent and art of Hollywood. We will tour the Hollywood Walk of Fame, a sidewalk along Hollywood Boulevard and Vine Street. In its floor there are located more than 2000 stars with the names of different celebrities.

programme.title: Leave No Trace
programme.desc: Orangutans are the world's largest tree-climbing mammals. But their forest habitat in Borneo is rapidly disappearing, putting the future of Asia's only great ape in peril. Staying at Sukau Rainforest Lodge, Richard sees first hand how the locals are fighting the threat not only to their environment, but also to the tourism industry. Along the way, Richard sees a range of animals in their natural habitat, and visits one of only 2 sources of birds nest soup.

programme.title: Adventure All Stars
programme.desc: Darwin is the capital of Australia’s Northern Territory and a former frontier outpost. It’s also a gateway to the massive Kakadu National Park. Darwin attracts travellers from all around the globe looking to experience its outdoor tropical lifestyle. If balmy nights, colourful characters and outdoor adventures are on your bucket list, you’ll want to visit Darwin – just like our All Stars!

programme.title: Adventure All Stars
programme.desc: Margaret River is a small town south of Perth in western Australia, known for its wineries, beaches migratory whales and coastal adventures. Stretching between 2 lighthouses north and south of the town, the region fringes the limestone caves and sea cliffs of Leeuwin-Naturaliste National Park. For over 50,000 years the Margaret River Region has supported one of the world’s longest, unbroken human occupations, resulting in an immensely deep connection to the land. Natural beauty, abundance of space, fine wine and fresh coastal air make this episode a must-watch.

programme.title: Adventure All Stars
programme.desc: Located in the Northern Rivers region of New South Wales, Australia, The Tweed is adjacent to the border with Queensland. Here, nature is more thana backdrop, it’s a source of inspiration: from tropical landscapes, ancient rainforests, and world-class adventures. The Tweed is a place where sparkling seaside villages, riverside towns and hinterland hamlets create endless holiday experiences. Once you discover this place, it’s hard to forget.

programme.title: Adventure All Stars
programme.desc: Marlborough is a region of New Zealand, at the northeastern tip of the South Island. It’s well known for Marlborough Sounds, an extensive network of coastal waterways, peninsulas and islands. This area also boasts some of the world’s best walking tracks, taking in coastal forest, coves, inlets, and spectacular skyline ridges. Marlborough’s diverse landscapes – from valleys of vines to sheltered waterways – offers the perfect destination for a week of unrivalled fun and adventure.

programme.title: Adventure All Stars
programme.desc: Brisbane, capital of Queensland, is a large city on the Brisbane River. This stunning sunshine capital has no shortage of bucket list items, and our All Stars certainly ticked off a few. During this trip we also got to experience Brisbane backyard, with Moreton Bay’s tropical islands on the city’s doorstep, including beautiful North Stradbroke. Add to this a dynamic cultural precinct, abundant wildlife and easy access adventure destinations like the Gold Coast and Great Barrier Reef, and you’ve got a destination you can’t say no to.

programme.title: Adventure All Stars
programme.desc: The Sapphire Coast is located approximately halfway between Melbourne and Sydney and just three hours from Canberra, located on the far south coast of New South Wales. The roll call of magnificence is almost endless in this gem-like stretch of coast, the most southerly in the state. Discover some of the world’s best whale watching, oysters plucked straight from pristine waters, beaches where yours will be the only footprints, immense tracts of national parks and serene ocean pools. Has a coastline ever been better named?

programme.title: Adventure All Stars
programme.desc: The Clare Valley is in South Australia about 100 kilometres north of Adelaide. This region is for those who seek substance and authenticity, taking the road less travelled and enjoy taking a moment to appreciate what life has to offer. With rolling countryside, world-class wines and spectacular views, the Clare Valley is a quintessentially Australian getaway. We asked our All Stars to “find the magic”, and in this episode they certainly did.

programme.title: Leave No Trace
programme.desc: Based on their "intelligent luxury" and "waste to wealth" philosophies, Soneva Fushi in the Maldives offers incredible insight into how environmental sensitivity doesn't preclude luxury. Eco-Centro is the heart of the resort, turning waste into recycled products.
